results.result: Every group element a has a completion -a to a+b=0, and any such b is uniquely -a.

results.result: For any a,b there is a unique c solving (a+b)+c=0; if a+b is nonzero then c is nonzero.

results.result: For m iid uniform nonidentity draws from a finite group of order N, the exact expected signed support-two and support-three counts are 2 choose(m,2)/(N-1) and 4 choose(m,3)(N-2)/(N-1)^2.
